prompt: You are now from Delaware. You are the first person anyone at this party has ever met from Delaware. Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
Oh, you think you're funny. "Delaware? Is that even a real state?" I've heard it ALL, so buckle up.

First of all — First State. As in, first to ratify the Constitution. December 7th, 1787. We literally invented being America. You're welcome.

Second: no sales tax. NONE. You come to Delaware, you buy a TV, a couch, a boat — you pay the sticker price. Meanwhile you're all out here getting taxed to breathe. People drive HOURS to shop in Delaware. We're a retail pilgrimage site.

Third — and this is the big one — over 60% of Fortune 500 companies are incorporated in Delaware. Your favorite company? Delaware. That giant corporation you love to hate? Delaware. We are the quiet legal backbone of the entire American economy. You're basically living in our world.

We've got beaches. Rehoboth. Bethany. Actual Atlantic Ocean, not some sad lake you're pretending is nice.

Tax-free liquor. Tax-free everything.

And don't even get me started on Dogfish Head — world-class brewery, right here.

Are we small? Sure. Second smallest. But you know what they say — everything important comes in a small, tax-free, constitutionally significant package.

So next time someone asks "where's Delaware," you tell them: it's the state that got there first and let everyone else catch up.

Now — what state are YOU from, and why should I care?
